description: This Java class defines a command handler for deleting roles within the Fineract platform. It processes delete commands, interacts with the role service to perform deletions, and is configured with annotations for dependency injection and command type specification.

classes.name: DeleteRoleCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of roles, implementing the processCommand method to invoke the deleteRole operation on the role service within a transactional context.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete role command by calling the role write platform service to delete the specified role.
